name: Track2Give
tagline: Tracks food expiry dates, warns before items spoil and suggests where to donate them.

awards: United Nations Sustainable Development Goals Enactus Challenge
Most Likely to Become a Startup

problem: Food expires unnoticed at home and goes to waste.
solution: Users add food items with expiry dates; the app counts down, sends alerts and suggests donation options, with an AI chat and receipt scanning.
demo_moment: Team-described: scan a receipt and see an item flagged for donation.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Beginner” and “United Nations Sustainable Development Goals Enactus Challenge” and “Most Likely to Become a Startup” among 217 submissions.
A beginner team that won three prizes, including startup potential.

lessons: Beginners can win broadly with a complete, simple loop.
